name: BuildHud
_doc: The shovel's panel at the bottom of the screen (src/client/BuildHud builds it, src/client/Build fills it; user 2026-10-27, the Bold look of the building UI drafts: "make it more distinct for each mode its in"). One panel: a tab over its top-left names the mode in the mode's colour; the body (see-through) has the status edge on the left (go / no-go, else the mode's colour), the title row (in Placing, the pieces before and after on Q / E either side), then what the mode needs (Destroy: the target's HP in stage blocks; Placing: a fits / why-not line; Trench plan: a rule with a tick per square), then the key caps. Each mode's face: Build a rim along the top, Destroy a hazard band, Placing a blueprint grid with corner ticks, Trench plan a chalk outline. A badge by the cursor shows the mode's icon. Sizes in reference pixels at theme.scale.referenceHeight, one UIScale. Colours: Config/Palette UI.BuildHud. One font, the game's basic font (user 2026-10-27). Desktop only.

faces._extent: how far the hazard stripes and the grid lines reach (reference pixels), past the widest and tallest panel

_pieces: what each piece is for, on the Placing line after its swings (Config/Build.Pieces keys)
